extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: A visual question answering dataset with questions that require reading and reasoning about text in images. It contains 45,336 questions on 28,408 images, with 10 ground-truth answers per question-image pair.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.rai:dataCollection: TextVQA was created by asking sighted humans questions on images from the Open Images dataset, focusing on categories that tend to contain text. Each question-image pair has 10 ground truth answers provided by humans.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 28,408 images from the Open Images dataset, especially images from categories that tend to contain text such as billboard, traffic sign, and whiteboard.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each question-image pair has 10 ground truth answers provided by humans.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 10 ground truth answers per question-image pair.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OCR model used to extract word tokens from images for the model's reading component.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper notes benchmark biases in the dataset and evaluates upper bounds based on OCR tokens and frequent answers, indicating that answer distributions and OCR-token availability may bias performance.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The OCR model still fails on rotated, unstructured (e.g., scribbled), or partially occluded text. The dataset is intended for questions that can only be answered by reading and reasoning about text in images, so it is not suitable for general VQA beyond this setting.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is motivated by applications that aid visually impaired users by enabling systems to answer questions about everyday images containing text.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is introduced for visual question answering on text-in-image questions, supporting research on reading and reasoning about text in images; it is used for train, validation, and test splits.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Questions were collected by humans on images from the Open Images dataset, restricted to categories that tend to contain text (e.g., billboard, traffic sign, whiteboard); each question-image pair has 10 ground truth answers provided by humans.
